The Arab kings.
many ... these {OCR?}.
In the year one thousand two hundred and two of the Greeks (891 of our Lord?):
a certain old man appeared in the region of 'Aqqula (Kufa),
in a village called Nasiriyya,
who multiplied fasting and prayer, and exhibited an ascetic life (renunciation).
And many of the people of the region followed him.
And he chose for himself twelve men according to the number of the Apostles,
and commanded them to teach the people a strange doctrine.
And when his affair was reported to the governor of the region,
he sent, arrested him, and imprisoned him in one of the rooms of his courtyard;
and he swore that the next morning he would crucify him.
And on that very night, the governor drank wine and became intoxicated.
And when they prepared for him to sleep,
he asked for the key to the small room in which the old man was imprisoned,
and placed it under his bolster.
Now his maidservant, who used to sleep with him,
because she knew that the old man was one who fasted and prayed,
felt sorry for him.
And when she saw that her master was deeply asleep,
she took the key and went and released the old man.
And she closed the door again,
and returned the key to its place.
And when the governor awoke,
and took the key and opened the door,
and did not find anyone in the room,
he was astonished.
And that girl was afraid to reveal that she had opened it and let him out;
and so his fame spread that he had gone out while the doors were shut.
And after a little while,
when two of his disciples were passing through lands that were far from the village,
he saw them and came to them,
and assured them, saying: "Angels brought me out and placed me in the wilderness."
And he wrote a book of faith and gave it to them,
that they might make disciples of people with it.
For he wrote thus:
"I, So-and-so, son of 'Uthman, from the village whose name is Nasiriyya:
there appeared to me in a vision Christ, who is Jesus,
and he is the Word,
and he is the Guide (Mahdi),
and he is Ahmad, son of Muhammad, son of al-Hanafiyya, of the sons of 'Ali,
and he is Gabriel."
